#  **Beetles Loves Earth***** | Recycling Ambassador Wanted*****💚**
> We’re officially opening a new** **round** **of the** Beetles Loves Earth Recycling Ambassador Program** 🌱

If you care about sustainability and want to help bring nail bottle recycling into more real-life spaces, we’d love to invite you to join us as a **Beetles Loves Earth Ambassador**.

This is your chance to help us grow a recycling movement for gel polish bottles — together, step by step 🥰

_______________________________________
# 🌍 **Who We’re Looking For**

We welcome anyone who is passionate about sustainability and community action:
* Nail Salon Owners
* Nail Technicians / Nail Artists
* Community sustainability advocates or local organizers
* School clubs or student eco groups
* **Anyone with a space (studio, shop, home setup, or community area) interested in recycling nail products**
* 
> No matter where you are, if you care about making a difference — you’re welcome here.

You can set up a Beetles recycling box in your space and help others easily return empty nail bottles for recycling.

_______________________________________
# 🌱 **Why Join Beetles Loves Earth?**

**1. ****Welcome Gift**** 🎁**
Selected ambassadors will receive a Beetles nail tools kit upon approval

·

**2. ****Reward Opportunities**** 💝**
Outstanding ambassadors may unlock exclusive Beetles gift boxes valued up to $100

·

**3. ****Long-Term Collaboration**** 💚**
Consistent ambassadors may be considered for ongoing collaboration opportunities, including early access to  new launches & PR kits

·

**4. ****Be Part of a Visible Sustainability Effort**** 🌍**
Help bring nail bottle recycling into real spaces like salons, studios, schools, and community environments

·

**5. ****Extra Rewards for Featured Content**** ✨**
Share photos or videos of your recycling setup (with permission for Beetles to use in content), and you may receive additional nail gifts and special rewards

_______________________________________
# 📦** How It Works (Recycling Box)**
* **Free recycling box provided**
* Prepaid return shipping included
* **No extra costs required**
* Simply help guide bottle drop-offs & keep the box area organized

_______________________________________
# 📩** How to Join** 

If you’d like to participate, please fill out the application form below👉

[[[[https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/LovesEarth](https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/LovesEarth)](https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/LovesEarth)](https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/LovesEarth)](https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/LovesEarth)

 

(U.S. only for this round)

·
## 💚 Let’s grow something better together!

Every small bottle counts — and every space can make a difference.

Thank you for being part of the Beetles Loves Earth journey 🌎✨

# **📌 Little Reminder & Contest Tip 💅**
> First of all, thank you all so much for joining our fun community challenges & nail contests — we absolutely LOVE seeing your creativity every time 🩷

But… here’s one tiny tip that helps us make sure we** don’t miss **your amazing entries 👀

When posting your contest entry, please add the contest hashtag in the CAPTION / MAIN POST TEXT only.

·

For example:
✅ Add at the end of your caption:  #ShowMeYourNails

·

Hashtags placed in the title cannot be properly tracked or searched on our side, and they also won’t function as clickable hashtags — which means your entry may not show up when we search for submissions 😭😭😭

**And we definitely don’t want to miss any gorgeous nails!**

·

Thank you again for always participating, supporting each other, & making this community so fun 🫶

posts.title:
Prep is EVERYTHING when it comes to retention and making your nails last 🙌🏽✨

• Lightly buff the shine from your nail tips—this helps the product grip better and prevents lifting
• Remove all dust after buffing (don’t skip this). Any leftover dust can cause peeling, lifting, and chipping
• Apply a dehydrator to remove oils so your base coat bonds properly

Now for the application 💅🏽

• Apply Beetles Base Coat and cure for 30–60 seconds depending on your lamp
• Go in with shade E461 as your base—apply 2 coats, curing in between for full coverage
• Add blooming gel (don’t cure yet 👀)
• Using E466, create your flowers
• Add 5 dots and let them bloom for about 10 seconds—once you love the look, cure
• Use E464 to finish detailing the flowers and cure again

To lock everything in 🔒✨

• Apply Beetles Top Coat, fully seal the nail, and cure for 60 seconds

This prep + process is what keeps your set looking fresh, glossy, and long-lasting 💖

Use Code NAILSBYA10

# **Beetles Recycling Pilot — Calling Nail Salons to Join First 🌱**

We’re starting something new — a recycling program for empty gel polish bottles, and we’re looking for a small group of nail salons in the **U.S.** to be part of our** first pilot**.
> It may start small, but it’s an important step toward building something more sustainable together.

*💭 The idea is simple:*

 make it easier for people to return empty bottles by placing a recycling box in local salons.

If you **run a nail salon**, we’d love to explore this with you. 

 Or feel free to **share** this with a salon owner you know — let’s spread the impact together! 🌱

____________________________________
# **What’s in it for your salon?**
*  🌱 Show your clients you care about **sustainability**
*  🌍 Connect with **more eco-conscious customers** in your area
*  🎁 **Get chances to be featured in Beetles’ eco content & future giveaways****!**

____________________________________
# **How to join:**

If your salon has space for a small recycling box (inside or near the entrance), you’re good to go. 
>   (Beetles will provide the recycling bin and coordinate regular pickups through our recycling partners —** no extra cost or heavy lifting needed** on your end.)

 🟢 Our **recycling bin measures** 10" x 10" x 19" (25.4cm x 25.4cm x 48.3cm) and fits easily in most spaces.

# 👉** Sign up here: **

[https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/042226](https://beetlesgel.aidaform.com/042226)

 (U.S. only for this pilot)

> Love Earth with Beetles. Start with One Bottle. 

**💚Thanks for taking a moment to check this out — let’s make small changes that add up.**
